title: lint: `validate-action-name-refs` does not walk `record:related_list.actions`, which the objectui renderer now resolves as action ids (objectui#11163), so a misspelled id is refused only at runtime
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from the at-tier review of PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11263 (objectui#11163, the ENFORCE follow-through on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665). Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are this repo's triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedup: none of the 184 open objectstack issues names `validate-action-name-refs` together with `record:related_list`; objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665 is the parent (the renderer half), not this lint.

## The gap

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-name-refs.ts` (objectstack `origin/main`, the docblock about `:27`–`:30`) walks `record:quick_actions.actionNames[]`, `record:alert`'s `action.actionName` and `page:header`'s `actions[]`. It says, deliberately, that "`actions` is declared separately on `record:related_list`", and does not walk it.
- That was right while no renderer read the key. PR objectui#11263 (objectui#11163) now resolves `record:related_list.actions` as action ids against the related object's declared actions: the same lookup `record:quick_actions.actionNames` uses. So the key is now an action-id reference list like its siblings.
- Result: an id that resolves nowhere is refused only at runtime. objectui draws a `role="status"` notice on the list naming it. At authoring time, `os validate` / the lint says nothing. That is the exact failure objectstack-ai/objectstack#20105 moved to authoring time for `page:header` and `record:alert`.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Walk `record:related_list` → `properties.actions[]` in the same rule, scoped to that component type, resolving each id against the related object's actions. The renderer resolves against the list's CHILD object, not the page's object, so the rule should too. Add a pin beside #20105's.

Dedupe words: `validate-action-name-refs related_list` · `record:related_list actions lint` · `action-name-undefined related list`
